name: Gobernación del Tolima
body: Every image on the home page has alt text, HSTS runs a year, and framing is limited. But robots.txt says Disallow: / to every crawler it does not name, so AI answer bots like PerplexityBot cannot read it.
lesson: Allow the search and AI answer crawlers you want to cite you, and block only the ones you mean to.
summary: tolima.gov.co scores 76 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 10 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 10 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search) by Disallow: /, ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: 24 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: 54 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Universal Analytics appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', script-src allows any host, object-src is not 'none'.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

works.title: Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 586 ms
Every page has a meta description
The sitemap matches the pages that were analyzed
